ex.en: They're fast runners.
ex.zh: 他們跑得很快。

ex.en: The two runners reached the finish line at the same time.
ex.zh: 兩名跑者同時抵達終點線。

ex.en: Tom is the fastest runner out of the three of us.
ex.zh: 湯姆是我們三個人當中跑得最快的。

ex.en: Rubber is not hard: it gives way to pressure.
ex.zh: 橡膠不硬：受到壓力就會變形。

ex.en: This isn't rubber.
ex.zh: 這不是橡膠。

ex.en: These boots are made of rubber.
ex.zh: 這雙靴子是橡膠做的。

ex.en: Can I borrow your rubber?
ex.zh: 可以借我你的橡皮擦嗎？

ex.en: I need a pencil and a rubber.
ex.zh: 我需要一支鉛筆和一塊橡皮擦。

ex.en: He never stepped on that rug.
ex.zh: 他從沒踩過那塊地毯。

ex.en: This rug is handmade.
ex.zh: 這塊地毯是手工做的。

ex.en: We put a new rug in the living room.
ex.zh: 我們在客廳鋪了一塊新地毯。

rug.zh: sweep (something) under the rug：掩蓋、隱瞞（問題）

ex.en: The company tried to sweep the problem under the rug.
ex.zh: 公司試圖把問題掩蓋起來。

ex.en: Don't sweep your mistakes under the rug.
ex.zh: 別把你的錯誤隱瞞起來。

ex.en: Draw a line with a ruler.
ex.zh: 用尺畫線。

ex.en: Can I borrow your ruler?
ex.zh: 我可以借你的尺嗎？

ex.en: The king was a wise ruler.
ex.zh: 那位國王是個英明的統治者。

ex.en: The country's rulers ignored the people's needs.
ex.zh: 這個國家的統治者忽視了人民的需求。

ex.en: He runs every day so he is very healthy.
ex.zh: 他每天跑步，所以身體很健康。

ex.en: A dog can run faster than a man can.
ex.zh: 狗跑得比人快。

ex.en: She runs a small café.
ex.zh: 她經營一家小咖啡館。

ex.en: Who runs this company?
ex.zh: 這家公司是誰在經營？

ex.en: The app runs on both iPhone and Android.
ex.zh: 這個 App 在 iPhone 和 Android 上都能執行。

ex.en: The buses run every ten minutes.
ex.zh: 公車每十分鐘一班。

ex.en: Nancy ran across an old friend of hers yesterday.
ex.zh: 南西昨天巧遇了她的一位老朋友。

ex.en: I ran across an old friend near the bank.
ex.zh: 我在銀行附近碰到一位老朋友。

ex.en: We've run out of paper.
ex.zh: 我們的紙用完了。

ex.en: My phone is running out of battery.
ex.zh: 我的手機快沒電了。

ex.en: The rules must be few and, more importantly, simple.
ex.zh: 規則要少，更重要的是要簡單。

ex.en: Every player is under obligation to keep the rules.
ex.zh: 每位選手都有義務遵守規則。

ex.en: The rule of the road must be strictly observed.
ex.zh: 交通規則必須嚴格遵守。

rule.zh: as a rule / make it a rule to：通常；習慣

ex.en: I make it a rule to keep early hours.
ex.zh: 我習慣早睡早起。

ex.en: As a rule, I don't work on weekends.
ex.zh: 我通常週末不工作。

ex.en: The court ruled in favor of the company.
ex.zh: 法院做出對該公司有利的判決。

ex.en: The king ruled the country for 40 years.
ex.zh: 國王統治這個國家四十年。

ex.en: The IMF ruled out any new loans to that country.
ex.zh: 國際貨幣基金組織排除了再貸款給該國的可能。

ex.en: We can't rule out the possibility of delays.
ex.zh: 我們不能排除延誤的可能。

ex.en: He rushed into the room with his coat on.
ex.zh: 他穿著外套衝進房間。

ex.en: She rushed home with the good news.
ex.zh: 她帶著好消息急忙跑回家。

ex.en: This thing can't be rushed; it needs long-term planning.
ex.zh: 這件事急不得，需要長遠規劃。

ex.en: Don't rush me. I need time to think.
ex.zh: 別催我，我需要時間想一想。

ex.en: I'm in a rush, so I'll call you later.
ex.zh: 我在趕時間，晚點再打給你。

ex.en: There's no rush. Take your time.
ex.zh: 不急，慢慢來。

ex.en: The busses are especially crowded during rush hour.
ex.zh: 上下班尖峰時段公車特別擠。

ex.en: There ought to be more buses during the rush hours.
ex.zh: 尖峰時段應該要有更多公車。

ex.en: It seems the rural area will be developed on a large scale.
ex.zh: 看來農村地區將被大規模開發。

ex.en: Asia has many rural villages.
ex.zh: 亞洲有許多鄉村。

ex.en: Many young people leave rural areas to find work.
ex.zh: 許多年輕人離開鄉下到外地找工作。

ex.en: The two of you have ruined my life.
ex.zh: 你們兩個毀了我的人生。

ex.en: This scandal will likely ruin your chances of being elected.
ex.zh: 這樁醜聞很可能毀掉你當選的機會。

ex.en: The rain ruined our picnic.
ex.zh: 這場雨毀了我們的野餐。

ex.en: A series of blasts reduced the laboratory to ruins.
ex.zh: 一連串的爆炸把實驗室夷為廢墟。

ex.en: There is an important ruin hidden under this gym.
ex.zh: 這座體育館底下藏著一處重要遺址。

ex.en: She rubbed her eyes.
ex.zh: 她揉了揉眼睛。

ex.en: Never rub your eyes when your hands are dirty.
ex.zh: 手髒的時候千萬不要揉眼睛。

ex.en: Rub some lotion on your hands.
ex.zh: 在手上抹一些乳液。

ex.en: Those two communicate a lot with each other at work, often rubbing shoulders.
ex.zh: 他們倆工作上常聯絡，經常打交道。

ex.en: At the conference, I rubbed shoulders with industry leaders.
ex.zh: 我在研討會上和業界領袖有所交流。

rub.zh: rub it in：哪壺不開提哪壺、一再提起（別人的錯）

ex.en: I know I made a mistake, so don't rub it in.
ex.zh: 我知道我犯錯了，別再一直提了。

ex.en: Stop rubbing it in!
ex.zh: 別再哪壺不開提哪壺了！

ex.en: There is a rumor that he has resigned.
ex.zh: 有傳言說他辭職了。

ex.en: It turned out that the rumor was false.
ex.zh: 結果那個謠言是假的。

ex.en: They say you shouldn't take rumors seriously, but that's easier said than done.
ex.zh: 大家都說不要把謠言當真，但說起來容易做起來難。

ex.en: The flight was delayed while crews inspected the runway.
ex.zh: 工作人員檢查跑道時，航班因此延誤。

ex.en: The designer sent the collection down the runway in March.
ex.zh: 設計師在三月讓這系列服裝登上伸展台。

ex.en: The busses are especially crowded during rush hour.
ex.zh: 尖峰時段公車特別擠。

ex.en: If we don't hit the road soon, we'll get caught in the morning rush hour traffic.
ex.zh: 如果我們不趕快出發，就會碰上早上的尖峰車潮。

ex.en: It was the morning rush hour, and there were a lot of passing pedestrians and cars.
ex.zh: 當時正是早上尖峰時間，路上行人和車輛很多。
